summary: Tested Website Shutdown Switch (maintenance mode) end-to-end. All 8 backend tests pass (cycle: get/put/wrong-password 403/reopen-past 400/customer login 503/customer token 503/register 503/POST leads 503/GET go 302 to /maintenance/admin endpoints unaffected/OFF restore; auto-reopen after ~75s works; regression: /go redirect + customer login). Frontend: shutdown ON, /login, /, /signup, /campaign/axis-mutual-fund-sip all show maintenance-page with IST reopen time + ticking countdown; maintenance-admin-link leads to functional /admin/login; ShutdownControl on /admin/security shows CLOSED, shutdown-active-info, toggle → confirm-box → password → OPEN toast; /login returns to normal login form. Logged-in customer scenario: after API turns shutdown ON, navigating to /wallet shows maintenance-page and rt_token is cleared from localStorage. Shutdown left OFF at end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is > 2500 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, campaigns, leads, wallet, admin, shutdown).
shutdown_state() re-queries DB inside HTTPException detail (get_current_user calls it twice; login and register call it twice). Minor perf; cache within request.

In go_affiliate the campaign-not-found branch runs BEFORE the shutdown check, so /api/go/<unknown-slug> goes to /offer-ended even during shutdown. Acceptable since slug is unknown, but note for consistency.
